changelog:
Initial release of Trinity Compress: a pre-run prompt compression tool for iterative AI development.

- Compresses prompt files before each loop run to save input tokens.
- Integrates with Ralph-style loops, agent/skill directories, and most token-billed providers.
- Operates entirely as a local script—no API or model calls required.
- Backs up original files as .bak for instant undo.
- Includes configuration file, bash/PowerShell installer scripts, and optional Makefile/.gitignore snippets.
summary: Compress prompt files locally before iterative AI loops to reduce input tokens, with backup and undo support, for Ralph-style loops and token-billed providers.
